about: What each evidence track can deliver. Source of truth for the README table under 'What you can do with only drawings, only process knowledge, or both' (python scripts/deliverables_matrix.py --write regenerates it; scripts/test_open100_structural.py checks they match and that every evidence path exists).

tracks.te: Tennessee Eastman: process knowledge only (hand-built seed model from the published process, recorded simulator replay), no P&ID
tracks.open100: OPEN100: 12 real P&IDs, extracted and scored, no process data

statuses.done: built and checked; the note says how far
statuses.done_offline: built and rendered offline; not imported into a gateway
statuses.partial: built for part of the plant; the note says how much
statuses.draft: draft stills or text, not reviewed
statuses.mockup: design mockup, not a procedure or a verified result
statuses.synthetic_demo: works end to end on synthetic inputs only
statuses.not_possible: cannot be done with this track's inputs; the note says what is missing
statuses.not_applicable: the question does not arise for this track
